# Public-domain EPUB fixtures

Unmodified Project Gutenberg EPUB3 downloads for automated import tests and optional manual reading tests. They are not bundled into the app or automatically imported.

Both works are by Lewis Carroll. Project Gutenberg lists these editions as public domain in the USA; outside the USA, check local copyright status. The original notices and full Project Gutenberg license remain inside each EPUB. These files are not relicensed under Quire's MIT license.

Downloaded 2026-09-13. Upstream files can change; SHA-256 identifies these exact copies.
